title: Instantiating the Knowledge Plane
abstract: arXiv:2611.07827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 2003, Clark et al. proposed the "Knowledge Plane", a layer of intelligent agents that share rich information about network state in order to collaboratively manage the Internet across administrative boundaries. The technology of the day lacked the two capabilities it demanded most: reasoning and unstructured communication. Thus, automated network management has remained largely confined to single domains, while interdomain problems are still resolved by human operators on the phone. We argue that agentic large language models can finally unlock the potential of the Knowledge Plane, but that doing so will require solving new research problems that arise particularly in this decentralized, multi-agent, coopetitive setting that have received limited attention in the literature thus far.

translated_abstract: 2003年，Clark等人提出了“知识平面”的概念——一个由智能代理组成的层次，这些代理共享丰富的网络状态信息，以便跨越管理边界协作管理互联网。然而，当时的技术缺乏它最需要的两种能力：推理和非结构化通信。因此，自动化网络管理在很大程度上仍局限于单一管理域内，而跨域问题至今仍需人工操作员通过电话来解决。本文认为，代理型大语言模型最终能够释放知识平面的潜力，但要实现这一点，需要解决在这一去中心化、多代理、竞合环境中特有的新研究问题，而这些问题迄今为止在文献中受到的关注有限。
tldr: 本文提出利用代理型大语言模型实现2003年Clark等人设想的“知识平面”，从而实现跨管理边界的自动化互联网协作管理，并指出必须解决去中心化、多代理、竞合环境下出现的新研究问题。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that agentic large language models can finally realize the "Knowledge Plane" vision proposed by Clark et al. in 2003, enabling automated cross-domain Internet management, but new research problems arising in decentralized, multi-agent, coopetitive settings must first be solved.
